name: Finite observability-saturation to square-chart local-inverse bridge

statement.latest: \operatorname{rank}D\mathcal O_{N,R}(x_*)=d_N-3,\quad S_N\pitchfork(\mathbb T^3\!\cdot x_*),\quad \dim S_N=d_N-3\;\Longrightarrow\;\exists\ H_N,S_N\supset B_N\ni x_*:\det DH_N(x_*)\ne0\text{ and }H_N|_{B_N}\text{ is locally invertible}
statement.note_ascii: at a fixed finite cutoff N, saturation of an invariant observation jet to the translation quotient dimension plus an explicit transverse symmetry slice lets one select a square observation subchart with nonsingular Jacobian and hence a local inverse

definitions.O_(N,R): finite total-energy or shell-energy observation jet through finite depth R
definitions.S_N: explicit local symmetry slice transverse to the three-dimensional translation orbit
definitions.H_N: a selected square set of d_N-3 observation coordinates restricted to S_N
definitions.B_N: a local neighborhood on the slice

parents.evidence: NSOBS-08 supplies local differential completeness modulo translations at saturation; the bridge makes the quotient chart explicit before invoking finite-dimensional inverse-function theory
EPSC-18 asks for a quantitative inverse radius; a nonsingular finite square chart is the local existence layer that must precede any quantitative radius

origin.source: Synthesis of the finite energy-observability programme and the EPSC quantitative-inverse programme in github.com/morrocwi/readout-problem-navier-stokes, 2026-09-10.

claim_boundary: This is a fixed-finite-N bridge theorem. Rank saturation alone is not a quantitative error certificate, does not choose a global branch, and does not imply arbitrary-N saturation or any continuum/Clay result.

name: Finite quantitative inner-certificate bridge from a saturated observation chart

statement.note_ascii: once a fixed finite saturated observation chart H_N has an explicit branch B_N, preconditioner A_N, and certified Jacobian defect q_N<1, measurement and forward-residual radii yield a quantitative finite-state radius rho_N

definitions.A_N: fixed finite preconditioner, ideally an exact or certified approximation to DH_N(x_*)^{-1}
definitions.q_N: certified induced-norm defect bound on the entire declared branch B_N
definitions.sigma_meas: certified observation-data radius in the declared chart norm
definitions.sigma_res: certified forward residual of the reconstructed finite state
definitions.rho_N: certified finite quotient-state error radius on the same branch

parents.evidence: starts from the explicit finite square chart and common branch supplied by the local bridge
this is the fail-closed quantitative form of the EPSC-18 inner inversion target

origin.source: Finite preconditioned inverse estimate implemented generically in github.com/morrocwi/information-discrete-math/idm/certified_local_inverse.py and instantiated for N=1 in github.com/morrocwi/readout-problem-navier-stokes reproduction checks.

claim_boundary: Requires certified same-branch containment, a certified symmetry slice, and q_N<1. If any obligation is missing the correct verdict is HOLD. This is finite-native and contains no completed-infinity premise.

name: Arbitrary-finite-resolution inner-certificate programme

statement.note_ascii: open programme: give a constructive certificate package for each arbitrary finite input N, rather than assume a completed infinite-resolution state

definitions.C_N: finite proof/certificate package consisting of symmetry slice, square observation chart, preconditioner, certified branch and Jacobian defect
definitions.arbitrary finite N: a schema/algorithm accepting any particular finite cutoff as input; not a completed N=infinity object

parents.evidence: all-N rank saturation would supply the structural observability layer but still would not by itself supply quantitative branches or conditioning
asks for the quantitative inner-certificate package at arbitrary finite resolution
a certified rho_N can later be composed with a separately proved outer beta_N; the continuum adapter remains logically downstream

origin.source: Finite-first research frontier isolated by the N=1 quantitative inversion work and the N=1,2,3 energy-observability programme, 2026-09-10.

claim_boundary: OPEN. Existing fixed-N certificates do not prove this schema. The statement deliberately avoids an N->infinity ontological premise; any continuum interpretation is an external adapter and requires its own beta_N theorem.
